download_dog.description: Download a dog as a file, so a later step can attach it to an email, post it to a chat or put it in storage. Pass a URL from an earlier step to fetch that exact dog, or leave it blank to draw one at random. Only RandomDog's own address is accepted, and a file too large to be worth pulling down is refused with its size rather than downloaded. No API key required.

dog.alt_text: A photo of a random dog

download_dog.name: download_dog

parameters.description: Optional. The exact dog to download, as returned by one of the other actions. Leave blank to draw one at random. Only RandomDog's own address is accepted.

examples.label: A dog from an earlier step

parameters.name: url

parameters.description: Optional. Which kinds of file to draw from when no URL is given. RandomDog's collection holds videos and animated GIFs as well as photographs, and a video URL cannot be shown in an image tag or an email, so still photographs are the default. Pick Anything at all for the whole collection, videos included.
parameters.name: media

parameters.description: Optional. Limit the draw to exact file extensions, comma-separated, e.g. png or jpg, png. Capitals and a leading dot are both fine: the collection holds .jpg and .JPG alike and they are treated as one extension. Setting this replaces What to draw.
parameters.name: extensions

list_dogs.description: List every dog in RandomDog's collection, a page at a time, to build a gallery or to work through the whole thing. Each row carries the file's URL and what kind of file it is. The result says both how many dogs matched and how many there are altogether, and a filter that matches nothing is an empty page rather than an error, so a workflow can branch on the count. No API key required.

description: Pull dogs into a workflow from RandomDog, an open collection of about a thousand dog photos, animations and videos that anyone can read: one at random for a daily picture, a handful at once for a gallery, or the whole collection a page at a time. Every dog comes back with alt text and with what kind of file it is, so a step can tell a photograph from a video before putting it in an email, and still photographs are what is drawn unless you ask for more. Count what the collection holds by format, or download a dog to post or attach. No account or API key required.
